usage: The word 垃圾桶 (laap6 saap3 tung2) functions as a noun referring to a container for waste or trash.
You can use it as the object of a sentence, for example, I put the paper in the trash bin.
It is often used with verbs related to throwing away or cleaning, like 扔 (tang1) to throw or 清理 (cing1 lei5) to clean.
You can ask for the location of the trash bin by using it in a question, for example, 'Where is the trash bin?'
